context: The integer n is positive. The variable i controls the outer loop, and j controls the inner loop.

frames.explanation: Set i = 1 and check whether i ≤ n. If true, enter the inner loop, reset j to 1, and check whether j ≤ n. If the inner condition is true, perform the task, increment j by 1, and check the inner condition again. If false, leave the inner loop, increment i by 1, and check the outer condition again. If the outer condition still holds, start the next inner loop at j = 1. The process ends only when the outer condition becomes false.
frames.title: Two nested loops

result: For each i, j takes every value from 1 through n. The task therefore runs n × n = n² times.
summary: The entire inner loop runs again on each pass through the outer loop. Together they determine how often the task runs.
title: Two nested loops
